BTC/USD Fade Strategies — S4-Fade & S5-Fade

After N consecutive same-color 15-min candles, bet the OPPOSITE direction  |  5 years (Binance BTCUSDT)  |  Binomial test, Bonferroni-corrected
Overview Equity Hourly Day of Week Session Monthly Heatmaps Ranked Table

Strategy Overview

Signal: When N consecutive 15-min candles close in the same direction (all green or all red), bet the next candle reverses. Entry = open of prediction candle, exit = close of same candle.
S4-Fade: N=4  |  S5-Fade: N=5
